app.title: ChatGPTCleaner
app.subtitle: Protect your privacy. You decide which conversations to keep.
app.openChatGpt: Open ChatGPT in a tab and launch ChatGPTCleaner from that tab.
app.displayError: ChatGPTCleaner could not display the manager. No new destructive operation was started.

refresh.failure: Refresh failed. The previous inventory is still active.
refresh.warning: Could not refresh data. The last successfully loaded state is still being shown.

operation.lockConflict: Deletion is running in another ChatGPTCleaner tab. You can still browse conversations here. Finish or stop it there before deleting conversations or changing protection here.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: Test data. Your ChatGPT account remains unchanged.

scheduling.rateTooltip: How many deletion attempts the app can start per minute. Retries count too. Default: 60/min.
scheduling.concurrencyTooltip: How many chats can be deleted at the same time. Default: 1. A higher number may not make deletion faster.
scheduling.saveFailure: Could not save the deletion scheduling settings.

selection.title: Selection
selection.allMatchingHelp: Selects all conversations matching the current filters, including those outside the current page.

table.title: Title
table.protectedTooltip: Protected — it will not be deleted.
table.projectProtectedTooltip: Project conversation — it cannot be deleted.
table.copyFailure: Could not copy the conversation ID.

confirmation.protectedSkipped_few: {{selectedCount}} conversations selected. {{count}} protected conversations will be skipped. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.protectedSkipped_many: {{selectedCount}} conversations selected. {{count}} protected conversations will be skipped. This cannot be undone.
confirmation.protectedSkipped_other: {{selectedCount}} conversations selected. {{count}} protected conversations will be skipped. This cannot be undone.

unprotectConfirmation.description: After protection is removed, these conversations can be deleted in bulk.

deletion.noEligibleSelected: No selected conversations remain eligible for deletion.
deletion.noEligibleConfirmed: No confirmed conversations remain eligible for deletion.

preflightFeedback.new-run: Checking protection and acquiring the deletion lock…

unbound.title: Launch ChatGPTCleaner from a ChatGPT tab
unbound.description: Open ChatGPT, then launch ChatGPTCleaner from that tab.

sourceLost.title: ChatGPT source tab is unavailable
sourceLost.description: Deletion has been disabled. Launch ChatGPTCleaner again from a ChatGPT tab.

authentication.title: Your ChatGPT session is unavailable
authentication.description: Sign in to ChatGPT and launch ChatGPTCleaner again.

destructiveFailure.title: ChatGPT rejected the deletion request
destructiveFailure.description: Deletion is blocked for safety. Review the deletion operation before trying again.

apiIncompatible.title: ChatGPT interface is not supported
apiIncompatible.description: This version of ChatGPTCleaner does not support the current ChatGPT interface. Deletion is blocked for safety.

inventoryIncomplete.title: Protection inventory is incomplete
inventoryIncomplete.description: Could not build the complete protection inventory. Deletion remains blocked.

protectedStorage.title: Protected conversation data is unavailable
protectedStorage.description: Protected conversation data could not be read safely. Deletion is blocked for safety.

readFailure.title: Could not load ChatGPT data
readFailure.description: Deletion remains blocked. Check your connection and try again.

other.title: Deletion is blocked
other.description: A safety check could not be completed. Review the deletion operation before trying again.

reasons.server: ChatGPT returned a temporary server error
reasons.sourceUnavailable: Source tab unavailable. Return to a valid ChatGPT tab and relaunch ChatGPTCleaner.
reasons.responseAnomaly: ChatGPT returned an incompatible deletion response
